title: CPU search
summary: Run the generated CPU search script without a model

overview.objective: Candidate parameters or constructions that improve this repository’s stated research target.
overview.method: The saved Python script reads an editable parameter plan, enumerates candidates, and performs exact checks. No model chooses candidates or interprets results during execution.
overview.meaning: A successful numerical or exact check is evidence at its stated scope. A mathematical theorem still needs the matching proof and verification.

title: Lean verification
summary: Check a candidate with the shared Lean server
request: Verify the latest relevant saved candidate for this repository. Read AGENTS.md, the research guide, RESEARCH_HANDOFF.md and the installed Lean-search skill. Inspect the shared server health and profiles using the supplied connection; never print the token. Select only a profile whose pinned challenge and terminal theorem match the candidate's actual scope. Submit that candidate, retain the job handle, follow the same job to completion, and inspect its source-bound build, axiom and Comparator receipts. If the connection, candidate or matching profile is missing, report the exact missing prerequisite and finish with needs_input; do not replace a repository theorem with the kernel-check fixture, install large dependencies or start cloud instances. A completed model turn is not a passed proof. Preserve failed jobs and report the precise verification level.

overview.objective: Whether a saved candidate proves the exact theorem required by this repository.
overview.method: The model checks available server profiles, submits to a matching challenge, and reviews the build, axiom audit and any required Comparator result.
overview.meaning: Missing profiles and failed checks remain visible. A generic service test cannot establish this repository’s theorem.
